Third of the same set, and the same blocker: workflows in `action_required` since 14 August, never started, so no checks are shown. Approving them on any one of #22683, #22684 or this should be enough.

Local run against current `main` — `evaluator.py` is untouched upstream since I opened this:

```
$ pytest tests/evaluation/test_retrieval_evaluator.py -q
1 passed
```

With only the change to `evaluator.py` reverted:

```
1 failed
```

The defect: `MultiModalRetrieverEvaluator` splits retrieved nodes into text and image results with two independent `isinstance` checks, and `ImageNode` subclasses `TextNode` — so every image node was also counted as a text result and both modes scored against the wrong set. The test is a new file with a retriever returning one of each, which is the smallest case that shows it.
